description:
Folded into fz-k22.23 before implementation. Published inventory gating is inseparable from producer-scoped callable member identity: filtering direct-only entries is correct, but native/interpreter need the same constructed value's member relation to preserve target/capture authority.

Retained discovery
BackendCallableEntry must represent actual BoundaryId publications only; direct target ABI is distinct. The final fz-k22.23 change must establish both without consumer-position re-selection.

Closure condition
Close as folded when fz-k22.23 lands the coherent direct/public/member-set model and full gates pass.
title: Keep direct-only callables out of first-class backend inventory
